node.statement: Node 1.1.2 is the explicit preliminary-product subclaim: once validated, it supplies a universal K_m and threshold e_m such that ||Z dot W||<=K_m||Z||||W|| for this compatible amplified pair. Combining that inequality with child #0 gives q_P(T_1)<=C_act*K_m*e*||Z||||W||q_R(X); enlarging the parent preliminary K so K>=K_m yields the stated bound. This child is deliberately dependent on 1.1.2, so 1.3.1 cannot validate before the missing amplified product estimate itself validates.
